speed resolution of the acquisition standard"}], "gaps": [{"span": "s5", "kind": "atom", "proposal": "`dev.posted_duration_limit` | the longest duration of standing or parking that a posted sign states for the stop, stand or region it designates or governs, read from the sign's legend as a duration (s) a formula compares with an elapsed time; absent where the legend is not read **Not a stand-in for:** whether the sign's time windows hold now (`prim.conditions_hold`), or a time of day (`env.civil_time`) | general — it decides when a halt at a designated stop becomes a breach: how long the road user may stand there", "nearest": "dev.zone_sign / dev.regulatory_sign: their 'conditions' attribute lists 'a duration limit' but §11 gives it no measure and prim.conditions_hold reads only time windows, occupancy and class; {"node_id": "LVMC_11_60_040", "law_refs": ["LVMC-11-60-040"], "subject": {"binder": "subject", "class_elements": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-LVMC-11-02-140::taxicab"]}, "segmentation": [{"id": "s1", "text": "The operator of a taxicab", "role": "subject"}, {"id": "s2", "text": "shall not stand or park such vehicle", "role": "obligation"}, {"id": "s3", "text": "upon any street", "role": "condition"}, {"id": "s4", "text": "at any place other than in a taxicab stand so designated as provided herein.", "role": "exception"}, {"id": "s5", "text": "This provision shall not prevent the operator of a taxicab from temporarily stopping", "role": "exception"}, {"id": "s6", "text": "in accordance with other stopping or parking regulations", "role": "exception"}, {"id": "s7", "text": "at any place for the purpose of and while actually engaged in the expeditious loading or unloading of passengers.", "role": "exception"}], "elements": [{"span": "s1", "atoms": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-LVMC-11-02-140::taxicab"], "derived": [], "justification": "'taxicab' is a defined term whose admitted aggregate is DEF-LVMC-11-02-140::taxicab ('a motor vehicle which is properly licensed under State and local law to provide taxicab service'); claimed as the aggregate, never as ru.taxicab. 'such vehicle' is the taxicab, and 'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, which the taxicab carries. {"node_id": "LVMC_11_60_090", "law_refs": ["LVMC-11-60-090"], "subject": {"binder": "subject", "class_elements": ["ru.taxicab"]}, "segmentation": [{"id": "s1", "text": "Any cab,", "role": "subject"}, {"id": "s2", "text": "upon leaving any stand designated in accordance with the provisions of this Section,", "role": "trigger"}, {"id": "s3", "text": "shall execute a right-hand turn,", "role": "obligation"}, {"id": "s4", "text": "when a sign is posted giving notice of this requirement,", "role": "condition"}, {"id": "s5", "text": "at the first street intersection after it leaves such stand.", "role": "condition"}], "elements": [{"span": "s1", "atoms": ["ru.taxicab"], "derived": [], "justification": "No definition applies to 'cab' in this law (the definitions table lists none), so it is mapped like other words: ru.taxicab, 'passenger vehicle for hire, identifiable by its markings', is the class a cab is. No aggregate is admitted for the word here, so the class atom is the carrier."}, {"span": "s2", "atoms": ["rel.occupies", "st.curb_zone"], "derived": [], "justification": "The 'stand designated in accordance with the provisions of this Section' (a taxistand section) is the taxicab stand, st.curb_zone of kind taxicab_stand ('a signed or marked length of curb; kind ∈ {..., taxicab_stand, ...}'). The table resolves 'stand' to DEF-NRS-484A-250, which defines the act of halting; the noun here names the place, so the definition's words are not the carrier. 'leaving' is the event at which the cab's footprint ceases to overlap that curb zone (rel.occupies false, having been true at the previous observation). Designation is read by the stand's presence (status)."}, {"span": "s3", "atoms": ["kin.yaw_rate", "rel.occupies"], "derived": ["drv.motion.right_turn_through_region"], "justification": "drv.motion.right_turn_through_region(a, r) denotes that 'Road user a has made a turn to the right through region r, recognized as it leaves r', with its heading change since entry in the right-turn band; it takes the intersection as its region argument, so the turn is judged at the intersection s5 singles out. kin.yaw_rate and rel.occupies are the atoms it reads."}, {"span": "s4", "atoms": ["dev.regulatory_sign", "dev.governs", "st.travel_region", "rel.occupies", "prim.conditions_hold"], "derived": [], "justification": "The posted sign is a dev.regulatory_sign of code right_turn_only ('a point regulation by catalogue code, ... right_turn_only'), read where it governs (dev.governs: 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls') a travel region the cab occupies (rel.occupies) at the observation it leaves the stand, with its conditions holding for the cab (prim.conditions_hold: 'any occupancy or class condition is met'), so a notice limited to taxicabs is read as such. The sign is a condition, not the turn itself ('a prohibition sign is a condition')."}, {"span": "s5", "atoms": ["rel.occupies", "st.intersection", "st.curb_zone"], "derived": [], "justification": "'the first street intersection after it leaves such stand' is the intersection r (st.intersection, 'the region where two roadways meet') whose exit the turn concept recognizes, such that since the observation the cab left 'such stand' — the same curb zone s2 binds — its footprint has overlapped no intersection other than r (rel.occupies). (prim.conditions_hold) governed (dev.governs) a travel region the subject occupied at d; and at every observation from d to t its footprint overlapped no intersection other than r (written with since: [for every intersection q not the same as r, not rel.occupies(subject, q)] since [the departure from k with the sign condition]).", "obligation": "At t, drv.motion.right_turn_through_region(subject, 'driver' (DEF-NRS-484A-080) names who controls the vehicle, a relational role, not membership: read through the vehicle's controlled motion (agency narrowing)."}, {"span": "s2", "atoms": ["dev.stop_sign", "dev.governs", "rel.occupies", "st.lane_enters", "st.intersection", "st.travel_region"], "derived": [], "justification": "The approach is the carrier c the vehicle occupies (rel.occupies) whose entrance end is the intersection r (st.lane_enters: 'the intersection region a directed approach carrier runs into at its entrance end'); the stop intersection is 'indicated by a stop sign' where a dev.stop_sign ('regulatory sign requiring a full halt') governs c (dev.governs: 'the travel regions whose traffic the device controls — a lane, ...'). st.travel_region is the kind of c, st.intersection the kind of r. 'The operator of' is read through the taxicab's controlled motion (agency narrowing)."}, {"span": "s2", "atoms": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle"], "derived": ["drv.motion.parked"], "justification": "'stand' (DEF-NRS-484A-250: 'the halting of a vehicle, whether occupied or not, otherwise than for the purpose of and while actually engaged in receiving or discharging passengers') contains 'park' (DEF-NRS-484A-155: 'the standing of a vehicle ... otherwise than temporarily'), so 'stand or park' is standing. drv.motion.parked denotes the road user at rest at every observation of a window of length min_duration ('A halt shorter than min_duration ... is not denoted'); with min_duration = p.standing_min_duration the purpose exclusion of the definition is read through the halt's duration (purpose narrowing). 'such vehicle' is the taxicab, and 'vehicle' is the admitted aggregate DEF-NRS-484A-320::vehicle, which the taxicab carries. Same concept as the index's 'shall: Not stand or park such vehicle'."}, {"span": "s3", "atoms": ["rel.occupies", "st.highway"], "derived": [], "justification": "'street' (DEF-NRS-484A-265: 'the entire width between the boundary lines of every highway inside the territorial limits of a city') is a highway: st.highway is 'the entire public way between its boundary lines, including sidewalks and shoulders' and is not a stand-in for the roadway, which the words do not narrow to. The city-limit qualification is the territorial scope of this city ordinance, within which every highway is a street. rel.occupies anchors the taxicab to the way. Same atoms as the index's 'upon any street'."}, {"span": "s4", "atoms": ["rel.occupies", "st.curb_zone"], "derived": [], "justification": "'taxicab stand' (DEF-NRS-484B-067: 'a fixed area in a highway parallel and adjacent to the curb or edge of the highway and set aside for taxicabs to stand for passengers') is st.curb_zone of kind taxicab_stand ('a signed or marked length of curb; kind ∈ {..., taxicab_stand, ...}'); rel.occupies ('a road user's footprint overlaps a lane / region (..., curb zone, ...)') places the standing taxicab in it. 'so designated as provided herein' is read by the presence of the signed or marked stand (status narrowing)."}, {"span": "s5", "atoms": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-LVMC-11-02-140::taxicab"], "derived": ["drv.motion.complete_halt"], "justification": "'temporarily stopping' (stopping, DEF-NRS-484A-260: 'any halting, even momentarily, of a vehicle') is a halt of the taxicab: drv.motion.complete_halt, 'at rest at the observation'. A halt that ends before p.standing_min_duration is not drv.motion.parked, so the temporary stop the words protect is outside the obligation of s2."}, {"span": "s7", "atoms": [], "derived": ["drv.motion.parked"], "justification": "'for the purpose of and while actually engaged in the expeditious loading or unloading of passengers' is a purpose, read through the halt's duration: a halt no longer than p.standing_min_duration, the passenger pick-up dwell at the curb, is not drv.motion.parked with that min_duration ('A halt shorter than min_duration, which may be the temporary halt the definition leaves out, is not denoted'), so it is excused 'at any place'."}], "operationalizations": [], "assumptions": [], "intentions": [], "compositions": [], "residues": [{"span": "s6", "why": "'This provision shall not prevent' a temporary passenger stop: the words leave such a stop to the other stopping and parking regulations, which judge it by their own rules. A temporary stop that breaches another regulation is that regulation's violation; under this provision it is neither standing nor parking (DEF-NRS-484A-250, DEF-NRS-484A-155), so this rule's verdict is the same whether or not the stop complies with the others.", "scope": "none"}], "binders": [{"name": "subject", "class_elements": ["ru.aggregate=DEF-LVMC-11-02-140::taxicab"]}], "applicability": "The subject is a taxicab (ru.aggregate DEF-LVMC-11-02-140::taxicab, a vehicle) whose footprint overlaps a highway (rel.occupies, st.highway) at the observation.", "obligation": "Wherever the subject stands — drv.motion.parked(subject) with speed_tol = p.halt_speed_tolerance and min_duration = p.standing_min_duration, i.e. at rest at every observation of the last p.standing_min_duration — its footprint overlaps a curb zone of kind taxicab_stand (rel.occupies, st.curb_zone). A halt shorter than p.standing_min_duration, the temporary stop for loading or unloading passengers, is not standing and is compliant at any place.", "params": ["p.halt_speed_tolerance", "p.standing_min_duration"], "narrowings": [{"span": "s1", "why": "'The operator of a taxicab' is read through the taxicab's controlled motion and halts, whoever or whatever controls it.", "kind": "observable_reading", "category": "agency"}, {"span": "s2", "why": "The definitions' exclusion of a halt 'for the purpose of and while actually engaged in receiving or discharging passengers' is read through the halt's duration: standing is a halt longer than p.standing_min_duration.", "kind": "observable_reading", "category": "purpose"}, {"span": "s4", "why": "'so designated as provided herein' is read by the presence of the signed or marked taxicab_stand curb zone.", "kind": "observable_reading", "category": "status"}, {"span": "s7", "why": "The purpose of loading or unloading passengers is read through a halt no longer than p.standing_min_duration.", "kind": "observable_reading", "category": "purpose"}], "scenarios": [{"name": "forbid", "expected": "violated", "narrative": "A taxicab halts at the curb of a city highway, outside any taxicab_stand curb zone, and stays at rest for 5 minutes."}, {"name": "permit", "expected": "compliant", "narrative": "A taxicab halts within a taxicab_stand curb zone of the highway and stays at rest for 5 minutes."}, {"name": "idle", "expected": "not_applicable", "narrative": "A taxicab stands for 5 minutes in a private parking lot whose footprint lies on no highway."}, {"name": "blind", "expected": "unknown", "narrative": "A taxicab is at the curb of a highway outside any taxicab stand for 5 minutes; the source supplies no speed, so whether it stands is unknown.", "masked": ["kin.speed"]}, {"name": "branch_1", "expected": "compliant", "narrative": "A taxicab halts 30 seconds at the curb outside any taxicab stand, a passenger boards, and it drives off: the halt is a temporary stop, not standing."}], "literals": [], "param_proposals": [{"name": "p.halt_speed_tolerance", "unit": "m/s", "value": 0.1, "convention": "the speed at or below which a sampled speed counts as no movement: the source's speed resolution", "source": "proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_12_070_B; speed resolution of the acquisition standard"}, {"name": "p.standing_min_duration", "unit": "s", "value": 60.0, "convention": "the longest halt counted as receiving or discharging passengers or loading rather than standing: a passenger pick-up dwell at the curb", "source": "proposed this iteration by LVMC_11_52_040_A; # Plan — batch 08 (iteration 001)

Eight laws, eight nodes, one new concept (`drv.motion.moving_backward`). Every node passes the validator. One node, `LVMC_11_60_030_A5`, carries an atom gap and will not be coded. No law-local aggregates (`aggregates.jsonl` is empty).

## New concept

**`drv.motion.moving_backward`** (used by `NRS_484B_113_2` and `NRS_484B_113_3`). The road user's velocity, projected onto its heading, is below minus `speed_tol`. It is a state at one observation, not an act, so the nodes that use it need no `occasion`. Backing is read from kinematics, never from `kin.gear`, as `kin.gear`'s contract requires. There is one parameter, the speed resolution, filled with `p.halt_speed_tolerance`. Nothing in the catalogue or the concepts proposed this iteration denotes backing. **What would reverse this:** an accepted concept that denotes motion against the heading; that concept would then be reused instead.

## Nodes

**`LVMC_11_60_030_A5` — gap, not coded.**
- **Spans reused from the index:**
  - subject: bus aggregate
  - exception: "other than a tour bus" (tour-bus aggregate)
  - place: bus-stop curb zone or transit stop, anchored by `rel.occupies`
- **Obligation:** "Not stand or park a bus", read as `drv.motion.complete_halt`.
- **The gap:** the duty turns on "a period of time longer than has been designated for such bus stop". The span borrows from LVMC 11.60.010 through a `definition` reference: "he may designate the length of time that a bus may stand or park at each".
  - The period belongs to each stop and is posted on that stop's sign.
  - The `conditions` attribute of `dev.zone_sign` and `dev.regulatory_sign` lists "a duration limit", but §11 gives no measure to read it. `prim.conditions_hold` decides only time windows, occupancy and class.
  - A reading parameter would fix one period for every stop, which contradicts "such bus stop".
  - So the node files the atom gap `dev.posted_duration_limit`.
- **What would reverse this:** an ontology measure (or primitive) that exposes a sign's posted duration.

**`LVMC_11_60_040`.**
- **Subject:** taxicab aggregate.
- **Applicability:** the taxicab is on a highway ("upon any street", same atoms as the index).
- **Obligation:** wherever it stands (`drv.motion.parked` with `min_duration = p.standing_min_duration`), it is in a `taxicab_stand` curb zone.
  - "stand or park" is read as standing, because standing contains parking under DEF-NRS-484A-250 and DEF-NRS-484A-155.
- **"at any place other than in a taxicab stand…"** is an exception span. A node may carry only one obligation span.
- **The second sentence (temporary passenger stop):**
  - It is carried by the halt-duration reading of purpose: a halt shorter than `p.standing_min_duration` is not standing.
  - "in accordance with other stopping or parking regulations" is a scope-`none` residue. This provision does not forbid such a stop. Whether the stop complies with other regulations is judged by those rules, and a non-standing halt gets the same verdict here either way.
- **What would reverse this:**
  - a label that treats a short passenger stop that breaks another regulation as a violation of this section; or
  - an accepted operator for "in compliance with law" (gap G22). The span would then become a composition.

**`LVMC_11_60_090`.**
- **Subject:** "cab" has no applicable definition in the table, so it maps to `ru.taxicab`.

Signs have a "duration limit" field, but there is no measure a rule can read it through. A single parameter wouldn't work either, because the period differs from stop to stop. So I filed an atom gap for a new `dev.posted_duration_limit`; this law stays blocked until it's decided.

A halt shorter than the passenger pick-up time (`p.standing_min_duration`) doesn't count as standing, which covers the "temporarily stopping" exception. - **Taxi right turn (`LVMC_11_60_090`):** at the exit of the first intersection after the cab leaves a stand, it must have turned right. - **Stop sign and yield sign (`NRS_484A_450_2`, `_3`):** these follow the ontology's rule for an act required before an event.
